title: Experimental narratives: A comparison of human crowdsourced storytelling and AI storytelling

bias_targets.methodology: Statistical analysis (including logistic regression) of character gender distributions across prompts, and qualitative and quantitative evaluation of the descriptive attributes, traits, and physical appearances associated with male versus female characters.
Analyzing and comparing the frequency of same-sex, polyamorous, and non-heteronormative relationship representations in human-written versus LLM-generated stories.

Examining textual descriptions for racial markers and using follow-up questionnaires (for human participants) and explicit follow-up prompts (for LLMs) to explicitly identify and evaluate the assigned race and ethnicity of the characters.
